visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Female with wavy gray hair is holding four green Mahjong tiles, looking down with a focused expression. She wears a cream t-shirt with a dog print. The setting is a brightly lit room with a black chair in the background. She occasionally covers her mouth with the tiles. (2) A man with pink hair and glasses appears, playing a tile on the table with his right hand. He wears a black t-shirt. The camera cuts to a top-down view showing a Mahjong table filled with white tiles. The lighting is consistent and bright studio-style illumination. (3) Close-up shot of hands picking a tile and placing it. The woman looks surprised, her eyes wide as she looks at the table. The camera uses quick jump cuts to focus on specific Mahjong tiles, emphasizing the tension of the game's final moments. (4) The woman celebrates her win by moving tiles and cheering with clenched fists. She smiles broadly at the camera. Yellow and white subtitles appear at the bottom of the screen. A dog-themed print on her t-shirt is clearly visible as she moves her upper body. (5) A blue graphic overlay titled "SML 賽事規則" appears in the center of the frame. The woman gestures with her hands while explaining the move, pointing at the tiles on the table. The man looks on with a skeptical facial expression, adjusting his glasses. (6) Both characters are shown in a wider shot, sitting together and speaking to an off-screen person. The woman gestures with both hands, appearing animated. A red pillow with a white "like" icon is visible on the right. The editing pace remains fast with multiple cuts. (7) The screen transitions to a black background with a white logo for "SML SUPER MAHJONG LEAGUE" in the center. The characters wave goodbye to the camera before the final cut. No other text or objects are visible in this concluding graphic phase.
